headlines.text: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on. Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin.

Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial. Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.
Seven Ethiopian rebel groups form new alliance. The groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years and now say they will work together.
US and China discuss AI safety plan ahead of Trump-Xi summit. Top US and Chinese officials held talks in New York on Sunday ahead of a Trump-Xi summit this week.

Jailed teacher convicted of sexual abuse secretly released early in Indonesia, BBC finds. Undercover footage recorded by the BBC reveals he has been released after serving less than half his sentence.
Presley Gerber, Cindy Crawford's son, dies aged 27. His family asked for privacy during a "very difficult and painful time" following the model's death.

Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband says he forgave her so he would not be 'eaten up inside forever'. Patrick Clancy gives his first interview since his wife's mistrial over the killing of their three young children.
Sydney policeman allegedly disguised himself as Uber Eats rider before murders. Beaumont Lamarre-Condon has pleaded not guilty to the 2024 murder of his ex-partner and his new boyfriend.
Burnham hails Greenland deal ahead of expected first Trump meeting. While Burnham praised the agreement, Lib Dem leader Ed Davey called it a "pretend" victory for Trump.

UK should 'team up' with Canada in new Europe alliance, Canadian minister tells BBC. It comes after European Commission President proposed "opening the door" for Canada to become an associate member of the EU.
Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested. Aleema Khanum is accused of mobilising her brother’s supporters ahead of country-wide protests.
Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers. Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.
Afghanistan says three killed in Pakistani air attacks. Three members of one family killed in air raid on house in Kunar province, Afghan Taliban deputy spokesperson says.
Mourinho fumes at referees in news conference after Madrid derby defeat. Fuming Real Madrid manager waves printouts of what he believes were clear red-card tackles by Atletico Madrid players.
Why can’t the UN stop wars?. The UN was created to help save the world from war. More than 80 years later, conflicts and atrocities continue.
Meloni promises to ban burqas, niqabs in Italy’s schools. Italy is planning to ban the burqa and niqab in schools and cap the number of foreign students per class.
Iran’s military says US preparing to resume strikes. Tehran threatens retaliation as Trump weighs military action while Qatar pushes to revive talks.
Massive explosions at Syrian army weapons depot near Aleppo. Explosions rocked a Syrian army ammunition depot south of Aleppo, injuring at least four people.
Imran Khan’s family says three sisters detained ahead of Islamabad march. Imran Khan’s family says three of his sisters have been detained in Lahore ahead of a march demanding his release.
Powerful explosions at Syrian army site near Aleppo injure at least four. Officials urge civilians to stay away from the site in al-Eis near Aleppo after a series of explosions.
Trump administration readies sweeping sanctions against ICC, reports say. Measures targeting the court itself could disrupt payments, IT services and investigations.
The Sahel and the UN: a smaller footprint, a different role. As UNGA 81 begins, the UN faces a changing Sahel demanding greater sovereignty.
Ethiopian armed groups forge alliance against government. Former adversaries say they will settle differences as fears grow of expanding war in Ethiopia.
Iran war live: Tehran says world will be ‘astonished’ by its new weapons. Tehran says it has learnt the US may be planning a new round of strikes, warns of retaliation 'without limitations'.
ICE officer shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas, officials say. An immigration attorney representing the man’s family identifies him as Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, a Venezuelan.
Ruling party dominates early results in Russia’s wartime parliamentary vote. The Kremlin wants the elections to showcase popular support for the war in Ukraine and legitimise its action.
France to summon Iran envoy after language centre closure in Tehran. Iran accuses the French language centre of conducting 'illegal acts that violated diplomatic conventions'.

Harrison Butker drills game-winner as Chiefs survive overtime thriller against Colts. Patrick Mahomes threw for 382 yards and three touchdowns as the Kansas City Chiefs outlasted the Indianapolis Colts in a wild overtime thriller.

Manhunt underway in California after armed suspect allegedly points gun at people, shoots at officers. California deputies urge local residents to lock their doors amid a manhunt for a suspect wanted for several felonies, including pointing a firearm at people.

Missing Carnival Panorama passenger jumped overboard off Mexico's coast. A male passenger jumped overboard from the Carnival Panorama as it sailed from Puerto Vallarta back to Long Beach, triggering a major search.

Taylor Swift has savage celebration after Travis Kelce scores first touchdown of 2026 season. Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season and NBC cameras caught Taylor Swift pointing to her wedding ring during the end zone celebration.

Patrick Clancy in his own words: Top takeaways from grieving father's first interview. Patrick Clancy told "60 Minutes" that baby Callan died in his arms after four agonizing days and recalled apologizing to his son in their final moments.

Cowboys' Cobie Durant gets stepped on in worst place possible during win over Commanders. Cobie Durant left the Dallas Cowboys' 37-20 win over Washington after a teammate accidentally stepped on him while he was down in the end zone.

Chad Gilbert, New Found Glory founding member and lead guitarist, dead at 45. Chad Gilbert, founding member and lead guitarist for New Found Glory, has died at the age of 45. He had battled adrenal cancer since 2021.

Cubs star Alex Bregman hospitalized after taking brutal foul ball to the face. Alex Bregman posted a photo showing his left eye swollen shut after a foul ball struck his face during the Cubs vs. Reds game, vowing to return.

Gorillaz frontman Damon Albarn holds up Palestinian flag during show after Macklemore tour removal. Gorillaz frontman Damon Albarn waved a Palestinian flag during a Florida show on Thursday in an apparent response to Macklemore's removal from Ed Sheeran's tour.

Lindsay Clancy holdout juror makes new promise as lawyer warns of public attacks. Lindsay Clancy's mistrial juror Michael P. Desronvil plans a personal statement while her defense team pursues a double jeopardy dismissal motion.

Jack Osbourne admits raising kids without a nanny isn’t as gnarly as he expected. Jack Osbourne and wife Aree are raising five kids with no nanny, finding a rhythm while the family navigates grief after Ozzy Osbourne's death.

Browns' Deshaun Watson may have silenced doubters after outlasting Baker Mayfield and 2-hour weather delay. Deshaun Watson threw for 238 yards and two touchdowns as the Cleveland Browns outlasted a two-hour weather delay to beat Baker Mayfield's Buccaneers.

Caitlin Clark shines, but Fever suffer embarrassing blowout loss to Mystics as playoff race heats up. Caitlin Clark scored 25 points but the Indiana Fever fell 93-77 to the Washington Mystics, slipping behind the Atlanta Dream for fourth seeding.

Washington Commanders face season-defining crisis as Jayden Daniels suffers another serious elbow injury. Jayden Daniels was carted off at halftime after appearing to dislocate his left elbow on the final play of the half against the Dallas Cowboys.

Jets collapse late against Packers, miss chance at first 2-0 start since 2015 in overtime loss. The New York Jets blew a 17-7 fourth quarter lead as the Green Bay Packers scored 13 unanswered points to win 20-17 in overtime at MetLife Stadium.
Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas. The person shot is in serious but stable condition, Austin Mayor Kirk Watson said in a press conference.

Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania. The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.

Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains.

Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones. President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk. In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.

The capture of Western Yemen is making the country's humanitarian crisis worse. NPR speaks with people in Yemen and in aid groups who say the fighting is displacing families to areas without enough aid to support them.

In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink. In the Lower Ninth Ward, an old Family Dollar stands covered in graffiti. It looks abandoned. But inside, it's a treasure trove — clothing, home goods, toys and books. And everything is free.

Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case. Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

U.S. childcare costs are astronomical. More families are turning to grandparents. Grandparents taking care of their grandkids is nothing new. But the surging cost of childcare in the U.S. has made familial support even more critical for some parents who struggle to afford it.

Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow. Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.
